eligibility_fields: Beneficiary database/household criteria; occupation/deprivation

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)

benefits: Promotes apprenticeship training through support to employers and apprentices.
eligibility_summary: Candidates meeting apprenticeship eligibility for the relevant trade/qualification and establishments registered under apprenticeship framework.
eligibility_fields: Age/education/trade rules vary by apprenticeship

scheme_name: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (CSSS)

benefits: Scholarship support for eligible specially-abled students in technical education.

eligibility_fields: Disability; technical program; institution; family income
